svg.title: 32. Butterfly stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Sit upright and put the soles of your feet together. Hold your ankles and let both knees move apart. Stay tall until you feel a gentle inner thigh stretch.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.nhs.uk/live-well/exercise/how-to-stretch-after-exercising/
